ModMetaData.name: Colonist Mutterings
ModMetaData.author: mossbrook
ModMetaData.description:
Your colonists now and then mutter a short line to themselves: when they are tired, hungry, low, or just bored.
The line floats above the colonist and goes into their social log.
No settings, no Harmony, safe to add or remove mid-save. Source included.
